title: Onani Master Kurosawa
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kurosawa, an isolated and scornful 14-year-old, secretly masturbates every day in an unused school girls' restroom. When he avenges a bullied classmate, Kitahara, by soiling her bullies' gym clothes, she discovers him and blackmails him into targeting other girls. The story turns from dark comedy to a drama about consequences, guilt and redemption.
life_message: It holds up facing one's wrongdoing, opening up to others and changing, rather than hiding in contempt and isolation.

content.note: Mostly school conflict; little physical violence reported (to verify).
Psychological tension, guilt and humiliation rather than horror.
Masturbation is the premise; sexual harassment of classmates and rape fantasies (ANN, MAL reviews, AniList tags); reviewers say not visually explicit.
Bullying, isolation, blackmail and self-loathing drive the plot (ANN, MangaUpdates, MAL reviews).
Soiling classmates' belongings as revenge and harassment; reviewers split on whether consequences are adequate.
